- HI: ḫi, ḪI — “to mix”, with A: plural marker of LID.GUD(.ḪI.A), Harper’s ZUN (§35)
- AS: aš, dil — in DIL.BAT (Dilbat), the simplest sign: one horizontal wedge
- MAH: MAḪ — “exalted”; in É.GAL.MAḪ and É.MAḪ
- KAR: KAR (the TE sign with extra strokes) — karûm “grain-heap”, kar (syllable) — in iz-za-kar “he declared” (zakārum), karum 
- SAL: ṣal — in ṣal-tum (Harper’s “warrior of Dagan”), SAL/MUNUS — “woman”, §40: Harper reads SAL alone as aššatum “wife” (?); 
- E2: É — “house, temple”; opens every temple name, Akkadian bītum, É.GAL-lum = ekallum “palace” (§32)
- BAR: bar — in Bar-zi-ba (Borsippa)
- NINNU: 50 — É.50 = Eninnu, “House Fifty”, Ningirsu’s temple
- KU3: KÙ — “pure, precious”; KÙ.BABBAR = kaspum “silver”, KÙ.GI = ḫurāṣum “gold”, KÙ.BABBAR = kaspum “silver”: kaspi-šu, kaspi
- GUD: GU₄ — “ox”, Akkadian alpum
- ARAD: ARAD — “slave, servant”, Akkadian wardum
- ANSHE: ANŠE — “donkey”, Akkadian imērum
- SHUBUR: ŠAḪ (šubur) — “pig”, Akkadian šaḫûm
- MA2: MÁ — “boat”, Akkadian eleppum
- KAK: KAK/GAG — “peg, nail”; MAŠ.EN.KAK = muškēnum, the commoner
- MIN: 2; with U: the numeral 12 (adi 12-šu “twelvefold”), 2 — II GÍN “two shekels” (§17)
- IA5: 5 — adi 5-šu “up to five times over” (§12)
- SHESH6: 6 — ITI VI{kam} “the sixth month” (§13)
- ITI: ITI — “month”, Akkadian warḫum: the UD “day” sign with 30 inside — a month of days
- KAM: after a numeral, makes it an ordinal: VI{kam} “the sixth”
- GIN2: GÍN — “shekel”, Akkadian šiqlum: the basic weight of silver, about 8.3 g, aga₃ — first sign of AGA₃.ÚS, Harper’s rid ṣâb
- SHA3: A.ŠÀ = eqlum “field” — the fief-land of §§26–41, ŠÀ — “heart, interior”
- AB2: ÁB — “cow”; opens Harper’s LID.GUD.ZUN = liātum “cattle” (§35)
- ERIN2: ERIM — “troops”: ṣāb nisḫātim “struck-off troops” (§33)
- GAR3: second sign of DAM.GÀR = tamkārum “merchant” (§40)
- GUN: GUN — biltum “yield, tribute”: nāši biltim “the rent-payer” (§37–38)
- GUR: gur — in i-gur-ma “he hired” (§26)
- KASKAL: KASKAL — “road, campaign”: ḫarrān šarrim (§33); elsewhere spelled ḫar-ra-an
- THREE: 3 — MU III{kam} “the third year” (§30)
- TIM: tim — in ni-is-ḫa-tim, bi-il-tim, ni-ip-la-tim, dim
- MAR: mar — in i-mar-ra-ar “he shall harrow” (§44)
- UZ3: uz — in i-zu-uz-zu “they shall divide” (§46)
- BURU14: BURU₁₄ = ebūrum “harvest”: ina ebūrim “at harvest” (§47, §49); Harper’s sign list: ebûru
- HAL: ḫal — in u-ḫal-li-qu “he destroyed” (ḫalāqum, §53)
- U8: U₈ — “ewe”; U₈.UDU{ḫi.a} = ṣēnū “sheep and goats, the flock” (§57–58)
- NAGA: second sign of SÍN in AB.SÍN = absinnum “furrow, ploughland” (§62; the identification on Harper’s plate is uncertain)
- LACUNA: 
- UN: un — in iš-ku-un “he placed” (§76 gap text)
